purpose: Shared county/municipality service-area and verified water-rule fallback seed for booking, Admin App, public API fallback, and local SEO pages.
fallback_behavior: If a specific town has no separate local override, use the verified county water-use rule. If a customer types a town not in the list, resolve to Other Oxford County location or Other Norfolk County location when the county is known; otherwise ask staff to confirm before dispatch.

service_areas.label: Other Oxford County location
service_areas.bylaw_note: Oxford County service area. Use the verified May 1–September 30 Oxford County outdoor water-use rule for exterior work that uses a hose or attachment.
service_areas.parking_rule: Use driveway/private property where possible; confirm safe legal parking and enough work space before dispatch.
service_areas.noise_rule: Respect local residential quiet expectations; avoid early/late machine noise unless the customer confirms it is acceptable.
service_areas.water_rule: Oxford County: restrictions are in effect May 1–September 30 under Oxford County By-law No. 4193-2002. Outdoor water use by hose or attachment, including washing vehicles and power washing, is allowed every other day by address parity: even-numbered addresses on even-numbered days and odd-numbered addresses on odd-numbered days. Allowed hours are residential 6:00–9:00 a.m. or 6:00–9:00 p.m.; commercial/industrial 8:00–10:00 a.m. or 3:00–5:00 p.m. Confirm the current municipal/county notice before dispatch.
service_areas.access_rule: Confirm hose/power availability, driveway slope, apartment/condo access, and any building rules before arrival.

service_areas.label: Other Norfolk County location
service_areas.bylaw_note: Norfolk County service area. Use the verified May 15–September 15 Norfolk County Water Restriction By-law rule for exterior work that uses customer water.
service_areas.parking_rule: Use driveway/private property where possible; confirm safe legal parking and enough work space before dispatch.
service_areas.noise_rule: Respect local residential quiet expectations; avoid early/late machine noise unless the customer confirms it is acceptable.
service_areas.water_rule: Norfolk County: seasonal watering restrictions run May 15–September 15 under the Water Restriction By-law. Outdoor water use is allowed only 9:00–11:00 a.m. and 7:00–10:00 p.m.; odd-numbered houses water on odd calendar days and even-numbered houses water on even calendar days. Newly planted sod is exempt for the first 24 hours when proof of installation date can be provided. Confirm the current County notice before dispatch.
service_areas.access_rule: Confirm hose/power availability, driveway slope, apartment/condo access, and any building rules before arrival.
